description: Train punctuality per station and day. Returns a list of records; pass next_cursor to get the next page. Fields: date (date); station (varchar): Location signature; station_name (varchar); arrivals (bigint); canceled (bigint); on_time (bigint): At most 5 minutes late; on_time_share (double): Share on time among cancelled and reported arrivals; avg_delay_min (double): Average delay, early counted as 0.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous result, for the next page
